app.name: Handpicked Admin
app.tagline: Pick good videos for your family; YouTube playlists update every day

auth.title: Admin sign-in
auth.description: Only Google accounts on the admin list can use this.
auth.notAdminBody: {{email}} is not on the admin list. Add it with the CLI's add-admin command, or sign in with another account.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Only channels and series enabled here are picked for the playlists.
sources.addHint: Paste a channel, video or playlist link. A video link adds its channel; a playlist link is treated as a drama series.
sources.topicRequired: Choose a topic for this channel first
sources.empty: No sources yet. Paste a link, or import subscriptions with the CLI's import-subs.
sources.deleteBody: Its fetched videos are deleted too. The playlist on YouTube is kept.

errors.invalid_url: That link isn't a YouTube channel, video or playlist
errors.not_found: No such channel or playlist on YouTube
errors.topic_required: Choose a topic for this channel first
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired; sign in again

sources.syncedNoChange: In sync with YouTube subscriptions; no changes
sources.synced: Synced with YouTube: {{added}} added, {{unsubscribed}} unsubscribed ({{disabled}} switched off)
sources.syncSkipped: YouTube returned no subscriptions, so nothing changed for safety. Check that the linked account is your parents'.
sources.unsubscribedHint: Your parents' account unsubscribed from this channel, so it was switched off.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Videos matching any rule stay out of the playlists. Check the preview before saving.
filters.minDurationHint: Videos of {{minutes}} minutes or less are dropped, which removes Shorts.
filters.excludeLiveHint: Covers live, upcoming, and recordings of past streams or premieres.
filters.keywordsHint: Videos whose title contains one of these are dropped (case-insensitive). Press Enter to add.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The {{count}} most recently fetched videos, using the current (including unsaved) rules.
preview.empty: No videos fetched yet. Use the update button at the top right.

runs.title: Run history
runs.description: Runs automatically at 5:00 every morning; use the button at the top right to update now.
runs.budgetExhausted: Today's quota ran out; the rest continues tomorrow.
runs.doneWithErrors: Updated, with {{count}} problems; see run history
runs.timeExhausted: This run ran out of time; the rest continues next run (update now, or tomorrow morning).
